title: Integration Testing Module
summary: This module houses a comprehensive suite of integration tests designed to validate the end-to-end functionality, performance, and stability of the Ollama application. It covers core API endpoints, advanced model capabilities, concurrency, context management, and tool-calling features.

nodes.label: API & Basic Functionality Tests
nodes.title: Core API & Basic Tests
nodes.description: Validates core API endpoints (chat, generate, list, show), basic functionalities like Unicode handling, and fundamental model interactions.

nodes.label: Advanced Model Capability Tests
nodes.title: Advanced Model Capabilities
nodes.description: Tests advanced model features including audio processing, text embeddings, image generation, and multi-modal vision understanding.

nodes.label: Concurrency & Context Tests
nodes.title: Concurrency & Context Management
nodes.description: Evaluates system performance under concurrent loads, resource management, and correct handling of conversational context and history.

nodes.label: Tool Calling Tests
nodes.title: Tool Calling Functionality
nodes.description: Verifies the API's tool-calling capabilities, from basic execution to complex multi-turn agent interactions under stress.

nodes.label: Ollama API Server
nodes.title: Ollama Core API Server
nodes.description: The central Ollama API server that processes requests for chat, generation, model management, and orchestrates model execution.

nodes.label: Language Models
nodes.title: Various Language Models
nodes.description: The diverse set of language models (LLMs, vision models, embedding models) managed and served by the Ollama application.

nodes.label: OpenAI Compatible API
nodes.title: OpenAI API Endpoint
nodes.description: An API endpoint that mimics the OpenAI API specification, used for testing compatibility with audio transcription and chat with audio.

groups.label: Integration Test Suites
groups.title: Integration Test Suites
groups.description: The collection of specialized test suites that validate different aspects of the Ollama application's functionality and performance.

groups.label: Ollama System Under Test
groups.title: Ollama System Under Test
groups.description: The core components of the Ollama application that are being validated by the integration tests.

groups.label: Model Resources & Endpoints
groups.title: Model Resources & Endpoints
groups.description: The language models and external API endpoints that the Ollama server utilizes and the tests interact with.
